title: CRM Microservice
goals: Provide a flat CRM customer-engagement domain foundation for account registration, opportunity qualification, quote preparation, service-case opening, marketing-campaign planning, and loyalty activity recording metadata.

Prepare ERP-grade SAP CRM/CX parity metadata without attaching durable customer master persistence, CDP unification, CPQ pricing, order-management mutation, service routing, marketing journey execution, message delivery, loyalty wallet settlement, Workflow execution, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment.
non_goals: No live sales-force automation runtime, CPQ pricing engine, customer data platform, service-routing engine, omnichannel messaging system, loyalty wallet, reward settlement, or marketing journey runtime.

No durable persistence, customer profile unification, order creation, ERP price synchronization, support knowledge-base integration, Workflow execution, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment.
No SAP, Oracle, Microsoft, Salesforce, or HubSpot exhaustive CRM parity claim.

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer account has tenant, legal entity, market, customer profile, primary contact, relationship tier, lifecycle score, consent basis, source refs, and registration evidence
acceptance_criteria.when: the CRM domain registers the customer account metadata
acceptance_criteria.then: account, tenant, legal entity, market, customer profile, contact, relationship tier, lifecycle score, consent, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, schema version, and false durable-customer-master/CDP/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered account has a lead ready to qualify into an opportunity with stage, estimated revenue, probability, close date, source refs, and evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: opportunity, lead, account, tenant, legal entity, market, stage, estimated revenue, probability, weighted revenue, close date, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, and false CPQ/forecast/Workflow/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a qualified opportunity has quote amount, discount, margin guardrail, valid-until date, source refs, and approval evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: quote, opportunity, account, tenant, legal entity, market, quote amount, discount, discount amount, net quote amount, margin guardrail, validity date, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, and false CPQ/order-management/ERP-price-sync/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered account opens a service case with product, priority, severity, open date, SLA due date, source refs, and case evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: case, account, tenant, legal entity, market, product ref, priority, severity, open/SLA dates, escalation flag, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, and false routing/knowledge-base/Workflow/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a marketing campaign has tenant, legal entity, market, segment, channel mix, consent basis, planned dates, budget, source refs, and evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: campaign, tenant, legal entity, market, segment, channel mix, consent, planned dates, budget, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, and false journey/message-delivery/CDP/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered account has loyalty activity with points delta, monetary value, activity date, source refs, and evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: loyalty activity, account, tenant, legal entity, market, points delta, earned/redeemed point split, monetary value, activity date, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, and false loyalty-wallet/reward-settlement/marketing-journey/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: untrusted identifiers, policy/source/evidence refs, dates, scores, amounts, probabilities, discounts, campaign dates, loyalty points, or overclaim paths enter the CRM domain
acceptance_criteria.then: prefix-only identifiers, path traversal, whitespace/control characters, credential-shaped refs, invalid dates, invalid lifecycle scores, zero amounts, invalid probabilities, discount guardrail violations, missing account registration, missing opportunity qualification, and zero loyalty points are refused

decision_log.decision: CRM enters the enterprise microservice set as a flat customer-engagement domain crate rather than a monolithic ERP/CRM suite; SAP CRM/CX parity is represented through Enterprise Suite composition while live SFA, CPQ, service routing, marketing journeys, CDP, loyalty wallet settlement, Workflow execution, runtime audit emission, and cloud deployment remain explicit non-claims.
